title: Michelle Yeoh to Visit the Philippines for 'Blade Runner 2099' Promo Tour
summary: Prime Video is bringing Academy Award winner Michelle Yeoh to visit the Philippines for an exclusive talent tour to promote the highly anticipated series "Blade Runner 2099."
